transcript.text: Now I'll compute order counts by region.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count ASC

transcript.text:
The "quiet region" is defined as the region whose customers placed the fewest orders. North has the lowest order count (259).
